atoms.text: The Jones family wants to go to Yosemite National Park, California for their summer holiday. Unfortunately, it is a very long distance from their home in London to their destination in the USA. Moreover, they don’t have a lot of time for their trip because school will start again soon.

atoms.a: In order to get to California as fast as possible, which mode of transportation should the Jones family use?

instruction.text: True or false? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: On the plane, they notice that most people drink orange juice.
During the flight, the second most popular drink is tomato juice.
The family notices that the least popular drink during the flight is water.

trainers.instruction: The family planned many activities for their holiday. Read what they did. In particular, pay attention to all the different modes of transportation they used.

atoms.text: After a long flight, the Jones family took a bus to get to their hotel. They were very exhausted and couldn’t wait to take a long nap.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='1000ms'/> After a long flight, the Jones family took a bus to get to their hotel. They were very exhausted and couldn’t wait to take a long nap.

atoms.text: The next day, they went for a long bike ride and explored the beautiful natural surroundings.
Then, they went horse riding along a river.
On their last day, they took a helicopter to a mountain summit and were able to enjoy a fantastic view. What an exceptional holiday!
